ehr_clinical_prediction_data_import.description:
Import structured tabular or domain-formatted inputs (CDISC ADaM/SDTM, time-series
panels, pre-computed count matrices) supplied by the SME. Mirrors `data_acquisition`
but for the clinical-trial and time-series-forecast project classes where inputs
are files-on-disk rather than repository accessions.

ehr_clinical_prediction_reporting.description:
Assemble narrative tables, figures, and summary text from upstream stage
outputs into a per-stage HTML / Markdown report. Modality-agnostic; bio
taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

ehr_clinical_prediction_time_series_deco.description:
Decompose a time-series panel into trend / seasonality / residual
components and run stationarity diagnostics. Method-neutral: the
concrete decomposition (STL, classical additive/multiplicative,
X-13ARIMA-SEATS) is selected at runtime by the agent. Closes
Phase 6.1 B.1 of the dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan —
the time_series_forecast archetype previously had no producer for
this stage and dispatch failed with GoalUnreachable.

ehr_clinical_prediction_time_series_fore.description:
Produce point forecasts + prediction intervals over the named
horizon and evaluate against a held-out window. Emits a tabular
forecast table tagged as a statistical estimate (data:0951) so
the v4 planner can match it to the
`time_series_forecast` archetype goal. Closes Phase 6.1 B.1 of
the dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan.

ehr_clinical_prediction_time_series_mode.description:
Fit a forecasting model family (ARIMA / state-space / exponential
smoothing / Prophet) to the decomposed panel. Method-neutral: the
concrete model family is chosen at runtime by the agent based on
the SME-named model and series characteristics; the atom emits a
fitted-model artifact consumed by the downstream forecast-evaluate
atom. Closes Phase 6.1 B.1 of the
dag-design-v3-v4-100-percent-closure plan.

final_reporting.description:
Assemble the project-level final report: cross-stage narrative, dashboard
index, key figures, methods + caveats. Final node before SME review.

metagenomics_data_acquisition.description:
Acquire raw experimental data from public repositories (SRA, GEO, ArrayExpress,
ENA, PRIDE, ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx) or SME-supplied paths. Emits a cohort manifest,
per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

metagenomics_discover_sequence_trimming.description: Discover method for sequence_trimming (options: trimmomatic, cutadapt, fastp, trim_galore). Surface set_intake_method.

metagenomics_discover_taxonomic_classifi.description: Discover method for taxonomic_classification (options: kraken2, metaphlan, qiime2_dada2, qiime2_deblur, bracken, centrifuge). Surface set_intake_method.

metagenomics_diversity_analysis.description:
Compute alpha (Shannon / Simpson / Chao1 / Faith PD) and beta (Bray-Curtis /
weighted-UniFrac / Jaccard) diversity from a taxonomic profile, plus
ordination (PCoA / NMDS) and group-comparison statistics (PERMANOVA /
ANOSIM). ecaax namespace per EDAM audit — operation:2238 (statistical
calculation) is over-broad.

metagenomics_raw_qc.description:
Run sequencing QC (FastQC, MultiQC) on raw FASTQ inputs. Emits a per-sample metric
table and aggregated report; downstream `sequence_trimming` reads the trim-needed
flag.

metagenomics_reporting.description:
Assemble narrative tables, figures, and summary text from upstream stage
outputs into a per-stage HTML / Markdown report. Modality-agnostic; bio
taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

metagenomics_sequence_trimming.description:
Trim adapters and low-quality bases from raw reads. Conditional in legacy
taxonomies on `raw_qc.result.needs_trimming`; the atom always runs and emits
trimmed FASTQ regardless of whether it altered the inputs (idempotent on
already-clean data).

metagenomics_survey_method_landscape.description:
Retrieve a context-scoped METHOD-LANDSCAPE for this analysis: for each
runtime method-choice axis in the workflow, gather candidate methods and
PMID/DOI/URL-anchored evidence, conditioned on the specific data
(organism, protocol, sample count, missingness from the upstream QC +
sample-manifest) and the analysis goal/modality. Honors
config/downstream-policy/source-discovery-policy.json. Emit a
method_landscape.csv where every row is locator-anchored with a
substring-verified evidence_quote. No synthesis; no ranking (the
discover_* atoms rank deterministically from this table).

metagenomics_taxonomic_classification.description:
Assign taxonomic identities to metagenomic reads or contigs. Kraken2 /
MetaPhlAn / QIIME2 (DADA2 / Deblur) / Bracken selected at runtime by
modality (shotgun vs amplicon).
